gitIgnoredAuthors: biome-migrate.yaml commits the migrated biome.jsonc to a Renovate branch as github-actions[bot]; without this, Renovate takes that commit for a manual edit, marks the pull request as edited and stops updating it.

customDatasources and the packageRules that use them: the tools that Freelens also has take the version Freelens has on main, not the newest release. See the packageRules for which ones. The custom datasources return one release, the version Freelens has, so those rules replace the current value rather than bump it: bump looks for the current version among the releases and skips a dependency with no lock file that it cannot find there.
mise.lock pins a checksum and a URL per tool per platform, but a local `mise install` re-locks only the platform it runs on and silently leaves the others stale.
Lock file maintenance runs plain `mise lock`, which refreshes every tool on every platform already in the file.
Defaults are disabled and weekly, hence the explicit settings. The packageRules keep it to mise.lock.

packageRules.description: No lock file maintenance by default.
Lock file maintenance for mise.lock only.
The Biome that Trunk runs takes the version Freelens runs with pnpm dlx in the scripts of its root package.json on main. The custom datasource has no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge is off.

The tools in mise.toml take the versions in mise.toml of Freelens on main. A tool added to mise.toml that Freelens does not have fails its lookup on the Dependency Dashboard, so it needs a rule of its own. The mise manager expects a leading v in the releases of tools that come from GitHub, which mise.toml does not have, so extractVersion makes it optional. The custom datasource has no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge is off.
The Node runtime of Trunk takes the version in mise.toml of Freelens on main, where Node is the version bundled in Electron. The custom datasource has no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge is off.

customManagers.description: Renovate hints after a comment: `# datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>`. A trailing ! of a version pinned in .trunk/trunk.yaml is left out of the version.

description: GitHub-hosted runners in a build matrix. The github-actions manager reads only a literal runs-on of a job, not ${{ matrix.runs-on }}, so without this a runner bump updates single jobs and leaves the matrix behind.
The value is split like that manager splits it, e.g. macos-15 into depName macos and version 15, with docker versioning so that a suffix such as -intel or -arm is kept.
The hint carries no depName, which keeps the generic regex above from matching the same line.

freelens-dlx.description: The version of a tool that a script in the root package.json of Freelens on main runs with pnpm dlx: the text after `dlx <name>@` up to the next space or the end of the script.

freelens-mise.description: The version of a tool in mise.toml of Freelens on main.
